response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to return to the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on most. Instead of rebuilding a view from scratch every time, save it once and jump back in with a single click. The feature is included in all paid plans, so every subscriber gets access as soon as they upgrade. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from sprint boards to client reports without hitting a limit in normal use. Views can be shared with your team, so a layout you build for stand-ups or planning becomes the default everyone opens, keeping reporting consistent across the group. No setup, migration, or configuration is required. Start organizing your workspace around the views that matter, whether that means a personal queue for today's tasks or a shared dashboard for the whole team to reference during meetings. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
